items.caption: A modern redraw of 前 in Shuowen small-seal style, showing a traditional seal-script form rather than an excavated artifact.
items.alt: A black seal-script rendering of 前 centered on a white background.
items.selection_reason: This identified seal-style form provides a useful visual reference alongside records of 前 in bronze and small-seal script. Its appearance does not resolve the competing accounts of 前’s graphic history.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw, not a dated inscription image; it cannot establish when 前 first appeared or resolve whether directional 歬 or a cutting graph came first.
